ag_walkthrough: WALKTHROUGH INSTRUCTIONS driving, no parking on a slope (RV fridges require level surface), toll road pass, leveling jacks, slide-outs, entry steps, stove/oven, microwave, tank dump, hookups, water pump, water heater, gas fill-up (when cool), generator (cool down, oil, full gas tank for dry-camping), propane, tow specs, emergency exit, house batteries, breaker/fuse boxes, fluid check, smoke alarms (2), CO/propane alarm (1)
ag_supplies: ***SUPPLIES kitchen & bathroom spray cleaner, dish soap, hand soap, black tank pods, septic safe toilet paper, paper towels
ag_insurance_note: *INSURANCE $500k policy; roadside coverage is optional and paid directly to MBA; premiums subject to change; renter pays deductibles
ag_intro: These terms are for the agreement between [owner] (Owner) and [renter] (Renter) for the 2020 Forest River FR3 32DS, [dates].
ag_s1: Handoff is [handoff]; return is [return], at the times entered on page 1. [days] rental days include [miles] miles and [generator] generator hours. Every driver must be listed and approved, provide a current valid driver license, and be at least 25 years of age. Renter is responsible for his occupants, guests, and approved drivers.
ag_s2: The initial subtotal is [subtotal], plus a [deposit] refundable security deposit, for [subtotal_and_deposit] before additional charges. The [reservation] nonrefundable reservation deposit (half the [rental_rate] rental rate, rounded down to the nearest dollar) is due at signing and credited toward that amount, leaving [balance] due at handoff. Optional items are charged only as selected and recorded. Additional fuel, mileage, generator use, propane, tolls, damage, and other applicable charges are due on return.
ag_s3: Renter must follow applicable laws, campground rules, and the walkthrough instructions. No smoking, roof access, or ladder climbing. Park on a reasonably level, permitted surface with safe clearances. Secure doors, windows, vents, and compartments; keep exhaust and ventilation unobstructed. Do not take the RV onto a racecourse, trail, or other off-road surface. Keep the awning retracted unless Owner authorizes use. No repairs or modifications without approval, except immediate steps needed to protect people or prevent further damage.
ag_s4: From handoff through return, Renter is responsible for loss or damage caused by his use, movement, negligence, breach of this agreement, or the acts of his occupants, guests, or approved drivers, including misuse of RV systems. Renter is responsible for tire damage during authorized possession or use. Replacement tires must be equivalent to TOYO tires meeting RV specifications and approved by Owner. Responsibility is not limited to the security deposit.
ag_s5: Insurance is charged at [insurance_day] per day for [days_in_words] days ([insurance_total]), subject to policy terms and claim decisions; the stated policy limit is $500,000. For each separate covered loss for which Renter is responsible, Renter will reimburse the applicable deductible, up to $1,000 per event, and any responsible loss insurance does not pay. Owner may deduct documented damage not covered by insurance and other unpaid amounts due under this agreement from the [deposit] security deposit. Owner will provide an itemized accounting and return the unused balance after inspection and reconciliation; no charge will be collected twice.
ag_s6: Renter will maintain AAA roadside assistance applicable to this rented motorhome; MBA roadside service is not charged. Renter must promptly notify Owner of accidents, damage, breakdowns, theft, or citations, take reasonable steps to prevent further loss, photograph the circumstances, and cooperate with claim requirements.
ag_rule1: All drivers must be at least 25 years of age, must be included on and sign the agreement, provide a photocopy of their current driver license upon signing, and show the current license at handoff.
ag_s7: Return the RV at the agreed time, remove belongings and trash, and leave its systems as instructed. The [cleaning] cleaning fee is refundable if returned clean; the [dump] dump/flush fee applies. An additional [excess_cleaning] excess cleaning fee applies if necessary. Pet fees cover cleaning only; pet damage remains Renter’s responsibility. Record return fuel, propane, odometer, and generator readings. Additional charges follow page 1, including the [late] late return fee if returned late.
ag_rule2: No smoking; no roof access, no climbing on ladder
ag_amenities: **AMENITIES FOR NO CHARGE (kitchenware, bathroom): Keurig coffee maker, toaster, utensils, lighter, microwavable dishes, bowls, coffee mugs, cups, baking pan, pots, pans, cooking knives, sponges, hot pads, ice cube trays, broom, dustpan, collapsable trash cans, Swiffer, toilet brush
ag_s8: Owner and Renter will document condition at handoff and return. Return does not waive a claim for damage that could not reasonably be identified at pickup. Owner will notify Renter promptly upon discovery and provide photographs and reasonable supporting costs. The signatures below acknowledge both pages of this agreement.
ag_specs: RV SPECS & AMENITIES seat belts: 8; length: 33 ft, 11 in; beds: 1 king, 1 full, 2 fold-out sofas, 1 dinette, 1 bunk (sleeps family of 10 or 6 adults); capacities (gallons): gasoline: 80; propane: 25; fresh water: 52; black water: 42; gray water: 42; leveling jacks, toll pass, indoor/outdoor showers, stove, oven, microwave, fridge/freezer, CD/AM/FM, 4 TVs, 2 smoke alarms, 1 CO/propane alarm
